# TPC-Havoc Q1_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  l_returnflag,
  l_linestatus,
  sum_qty,
  sum_base_price,
  sum_disc_price,
  sum_charge,
  avg_qty,
  avg_price,
  avg_disc,
  count_order
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus,
    SUM(l_quantity) OVER w AS sum_qty,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) OVER w AS sum_base_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (
      1 - l_discount
    )) OVER w AS sum_disc_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (
      1 - l_discount
    ) * (
      1 + l_tax
    )) OVER w AS sum_charge,
    AVG(l_quantity) OVER w AS avg_qty,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) OVER w AS avg_price,
    AVG(l_discount) OVER w AS avg_disc,
    COUNT(*) OVER w AS count_order,
    COUNT(*) OVER w AS _w
  FROM lineitem
  WHERE
    l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY'
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus)
  ORDER BY
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus
) AS _t
WHERE
  _w > 0
```
